label: PF Backlog 697
title: Context & Prompt Compiler: dynamic budget allocation, sliding token budgets, section prioritization, and truncation defense
body:
## Problem / why
Ad-hoc string concatenation of prompts causes context window overflow, silent truncation of critical rules, and high token costs.

## Goal & value
Implement the Context and Prompt Compiler enforcing strict token budgets per agent and stage, with deterministic prioritization and truncation defense.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-12`
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-17`

## In scope
- Token budget manager allocating budget across System, CAG Prefix, Memory/RAG, and Scratchpad.
- Priority-ranked context section assembler.
- Truncation defense strictly protecting non-negotiable rules and task objectives.

## Out of scope
- Arbitrary unbudgeted prompt expansion.

## Definition of Done
- Compiler tests prove context never exceeds configured token limits under high payload volume.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
